$comment: unevaluatedProperties:false is a producer-side guard enforced at contract-test time (forbids accidental leakage of state-bearing fields — e.g. policy rules or obligations — into the event bus). Runtime consumer decoder is intentionally lenient per ADR-202605031600 §4 metadata-only event policy — schema strictness and decoder lenience are complementary layers, not a double semantics drift.
title: event.policy.updated.v1.payload
description: Metadata-only notification: subscribers MUST refetch via GET /api/v1/access/policies/{policyId} to obtain the current policy state. ref: NATS subject+bytes / Watermill payload-bytes boundary.

policyId.description: non-blank policy identifier; matches Policy.ID validation

version.description: policy version after the change; starts at 1, matches Policy.Version

action.description: The mutation that triggered this event. Valid values: created, updated, deleted.

actorId.description: Principal ID of the actor who made the change.
